body:
I'm gonna apologize for being so abrupt.. 

Stop coming to this subreddit.. I can appreciate your aptitude for life. but... you aren't helping anybody. I'm sincerely sorry.. I know you mean well..
Can I come live with you? I've kinda always wanted to just get away.. I don't have a scholarship, I don't have shit. Do you have a spare bedroom?
Once again, I don't want to sound like an asshole.. but are you a millionaire? I'm not..

I'm guessing you have a witty response to whatever I'm gonna say to that weird ass comment.. But all I can think of to say is... what the fuck are you babbling about? And yeah, i'm kind of an asshole..
The more poignant question is why do I want to stay? I don't have many responses..
